assessor: OpenAI Codex, one dependent AI assessor in this interactive session; no human labels
evidence_scope: First pass over all473 new identity-ordered titles, types and stored descriptions/snippets, retaining917 earlier source-reviewed AI labels unchanged. Full bulletin/metadata passages and new live MCP evidence are reserved for the sequential review. Historical releases are valid for undated topic-discovery queries; no recency intent is invented.
limitations: One non-independent AI assessor knows the implementation and prior judgments. No human validation or inter-rater agreement. Portal searches all public types, literal only downloadable flows, and the three OpenSearch variants share the3424-document metadata snapshot. Pooled recall is not exhaustive corpus recall; repeated historical releases and methodology records are separate IDs.

rubric.2: Stored evidence directly supports the target concept and requested population/geography or explicitly advertises a suitable breakdown.
rubric.1: Related context, a narrower/broader measure, revisions, or unconfirmed requested scope; not sufficient as a direct answer.
rubric.0: Unrelated or a different/misleading measure, including enterprise births versus baby births and resident foreigners versus tourists.
